sentences.japanese: 愛は愛から飛び去る翼があるに違いないが、また飛んで戻って来る翼も持っているに違いない。
sentences.english: Love undeniably has wings to fly away from love, but it's also undeniable that it also has wings to fly back.

sentences.japanese: もし翼があれば、月まで飛んで行けるだろうか。
sentences.english: If we had wings, could we fly to the moon?

sentences.japanese: もし私に翼があれば、君のところへ飛んでいくのだが。
sentences.english: If I had wings, I would fly to you.

sentences.japanese: もし私に空を飛ぶ翼があったら、彼女を助けに行ったのに。
sentences.english: If I had wings to fly, I would have gone to save her.

sentences.japanese: 空を飛べる翼があったら彼女を助けに行ったのに。
sentences.english: If I had wings to fly, I would have gone to save her.
